means: The top end of the same score axis whose bottom end is 'worst quality' - a training-set quality bucket, not a visible property of the image.
does: Part of the four-tag block this project measured as load-bearing; it contributes finish and sharpness rather than any specific content. Because it is a POLE ON AN AXIS rather than a description, it is the natural partner to putting 'worst quality' in the negative - you push the same scalar from both ends at once. That is the standard Animagine recipe and the reason both words appear in this project prompts, one in each half.
reach_for_it: always, on the anime path, as part of the block - and pair it with 'worst quality' in the negative rather than using either pole alone
used_in: the tail of every prompt in movies/derby-ep1.json and derby-qwen.json, opposite 'worst quality, lowres' in the standing negative
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
